scope: exact-label Ｓ級予選, early segment; main line size >=3; strongest rival size >=2
selection_rationale: A broader coarse-grid search found many dual-year profitable conditions, but many were dominated by one large payout. Before reading any 2023 strategy outcome, a development-only robustness screen required at least 3 hits per year and no single payout above 70% of that year's total payout. Two candidates survived. This two-condition rule had the higher worst-year ROI (135.5%) while retaining low payout concentration and a coherent pre-race interpretation: the rival leader is clearly stronger than A, while the main pair is not overwhelmingly stronger than the rival pair.
supersedes: The earlier SKIP_ALL_EARLY pre-2023 draft was deliberately reopened before any 2023 strategy outcome was evaluated. This file is the new frozen early V2 specification.
freeze_rule: Do not alter the entrance thresholds, formation, stake, or add/remove early bets after inspecting 2023 outcomes. Any later early strategy must be separately versioned and requires a fresh OOS year.
